article.story: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. -- — Emondrek Erkins-Ford had 14 points in Western Kentucky's 78-51 win against Campbellsville on Wednesday. Erkins-Ford went 6 of 10 from the field for the Hilltoppers (3-1). Teagan Moore added 12 points while finishing 5 of 7 from the floor and had three steals. Armelo Boone shot 4 of 5 from the field and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 10 points. Dalton Kramer finished with 10 points for the Tigers. Cannon Young added 10 points for Campbellsville. Eli Brooks also had six points and seven rebounds. Western Kentucky took the lead with 14:35 left in the first half and did not trail again. Erkins-Ford led the Hilltoppers in scoring with eight points in the first half to help put them up 35-22 at the break. Western Kentucky pulled away with a 14-2 run in the second half to extend a five-point lead to 17 points. They outscored Campbellsville by 14 points in the final half, as Boone led the way with a team-high seven second-half points. Up next Western Kentucky visits Tulsa in its next matchup on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
